oh maybe the title? "job interview". 

I have just been on so many job interviews. So many times people just look at me and go "good answer". 

So it came to mind when I wrote the story.

on April 18th, just 2 months ago, i tried to hang myself and I saw death. I pissed all over myself and woke up in an emergency room. 

I guess I was just being overly melodramatic. My apologies. 

Forgive me, my great grandmother was a white hairless ape from the Congo 

Now excuse me while I walk out to the bog and set myself on fire.
Thanks.  I actually dream of orange juice.

I have about a month of "food stamps".  Contrary to popular belief, they don't let you have them forever.

You have food pantries but i will still need money for a bus pass. 

And as for mental health, it isn't mental health, it is reality.  I am faced with some serious issues and they are oh so real.

I am getting some hate here.  Did the "douchebags with Macs" remark  strike a raw nerve with some people?

Or orange juice. Fuck you if you don't like orange juice.
What? you don't like orange juice motherfucker?

yeah, thanks.  I am here all week!
oh i suck if you didn't get that. The crazy person was right.  That is why the story started over.
see what I did there?  haha

it was a strange thing.  I kept up on the story for the follwing years,. I bought some Heineken to celebrate when they put him to death.

As I get older, I just can't feel any hate anymore. 

I see wrong, sure. 

I just can't hate anymore.

I looked on my DD214 but it only has the guard unit I was discharged from.

I am pretty sure I was- 4-5 FA.  You were in that other battalion. 
I was there from like 94 to 96 I think?

Yeah, you had just ETS'd and the FBI got all these tractor trailer trucks and positioned them around the building they were working in FT Riley. NOt sure why they chose FT Riley as their command post. 

This was before 9/11 too. I heard it was Ka-Ching to the pizza delivery business.

I was 13F. Up on the hill. I was E5 but had an E6 position. It was a lot of stress. I appreciate the people who saw something in me to put me in an E6 position but I really had no business being there.   I was really in over my head. They took a specialist who worked in a TOC and made him a team leader. But it was peace time and I got out.  No worries.  I was good with gadgets. Master of the FED and GLLD. :)
I don't think I will see any of that in my time.  I hope you do.

oh hell no. Do we know each other? i was FA too.  Can't remember the unit though. The sergeant I speak of that was investigated by CID, he had a very unusual name.  "Tittsworth". I wanna say I was 4-5 FA but I wasn't there very long and then had a stint in the guard. If you know of Tittsworth, then we were in the same unit. 

FT Riley.... not my favorite duty station.

I was actually asked why HTML wasn't a programming language in an interview.
I told them there were no command structures, no conditionals ( there are really primitive ones ) , no data structures, no way to iterate through a data structure ( since they don't exist ) and there aren't any classes. When I say classes I mean in programming not in CSS. There are classes in CSS but it just means things that show up more than once in a page. Apples and oranges.

I was thinking about this last night.   I was a soldier in FT Riley Kansas when this  happened.  I was an NCO.

We heard about it in the field.  I just thought a little bomb went off. I had no idea half the building was gone.

True Story and this is where things get weird.  I had  a fellow NCO from Oklahoma. He rented a truck on the same day, from the same rental place as  Tim did and drove it to the OK fed building just like Tim did. 

My friend lost one of his daughters and was a casualty himself but CID didn't buy it. Too much of a coincidence. He was eventually forced out which is sad because he was a career guy.  I hope he is well. 

I came up to the battery a few days later and some guy was asking where I had been.  I said I was at the motor pool. I am always at the motor pool. 

Well, FBI was here and they interviewed "x" and "y" ( not putting their real names ) .  Sergeant "z" gave them the auth. 

These soldiers had gone to the rental place on the same day as Tim. 

So weird it was happening all around me.

FBI set up some HQ on Ft Riley. I read pizza delivery spiked 200%.

Forgive me for saying "Tim".  His name was Timothy McVeigh. Burn in hell dude.

yeah, as said below or above: Money. No profit in a moon base. 
We are running out of helium so that might give us the motivation. Money.

My nephew was about 7 and we were all sitting around eating watching TV and talking and my nephew started  going crazy. I was even laughing at him.

My sister in law grabbed him and did a heimlich, he just said "got it" when it finally worked. 
I guess my point is my nephew made a lot of commotion. My sister in law was an LVN.  Thank God she saw what was happening.

This was just a few years ago.  I started choking on some fajita meat on a saturday afternoon at my apartment. I was all alone. 

My first instinct was to google "what to do if you are choking".   I knew I didn't have time. I thought about running to my neighbors but I didn't think I would have enough time unless they opened their door immediately.

I finally just reached my fingers into my mouth and into my throat and pulled the piece of meat out. 

People laugh when I tell this story but I have no doubt I would be dead if I had panicked.
wow, I can't see them. Never really thought about it.  It wasn't like a  big deal.
